_why: Row 2903: `h_mad_failure_diff.py run` must end UNREADABLE reason=subject-changed when the subject tree changes during a subject run, including an edit reverted mid-run, and must not fire on ignored paths or its own --log-dir. Each mutant blinds one half of the snapshot comparison or widens what counts as the subject.
command: subject_tree_changed or ignored_path or log_dir_inside or log_dir_covering or listing or unstattable or control_parent_inside or earlier_run or fifteen

mutations.name: S1: CHANGE IGNORED. A changed subject is measured as though it were the tree named in SUBJECT:, the pre-fix behaviour.
S2: SIZE ONLY. Comparing sizes alone misses an edit reverted mid-run, the reported case.
S3: TRACKED ONLY. A file created mid-run is not listed, so it is never seen.
S4: KEYS ONLY BEFORE. A path present after but not before is ignored, so a created file is missed.
mutations.find: return [rel for rel in sorted(set(before) | set(after))

mutations.name: S5: IGNORED PATHS COUNT. Listing ignored files makes __pycache__ writes read as a subject change.
S6: LOG DIR COUNTS. The run's own logs inside the subject read as a subject change.
mutations.find: if any(_under(str(path), str(exclude)) for exclude in excludes):  # M:FD-SNAP-EXCLUDE

mutations.name: S7: LOG DIR COVERS SUBJECT. A --log-dir equal to or above the subject excludes every file, so both snapshots are empty and a mid-run change ends SAME.
S8: LIST EXIT IGNORED. A failing `git ls-files` reads as an empty, unchanged tree.
S9: LISTING WARNING IGNORED. Files under an unreadable untracked dir silently fall outside the snapshot.
S10: UNSTATTABLE SKIPPED. A file that cannot be stat'd is dropped instead of failing the snapshot.
S11: CONTROL COUNTS. A control worktree inside the subject reads its own writes as a subject change.
S12: LAST RUN ONLY. Comparing only after the last subject run misnames when the change was seen.
mutations.replace: if side == "subject" and index == args.repeat:  # M:FD-SNAP-SIDE

mutations.name: S13: OVERFLOW UNCOUNTED. Past 14 changed paths the rest vanish with no count.
mutations.find: if len(changed) > 14:  # M:FD-SNAP-MORE; `_unreadable` keeps 15 tail lines
mutations.replace: if False:  # M:FD-SNAP-MORE; `_unreadable` keeps 15 tail lines
